ownership: Original app-owned Race Day Dreams generated artwork; distributed as MIT project contributions. No third-party photographs, organiser artwork, race logos or sponsor branding are incorporated.
purpose: Offline decorative city heroes and illustrated route-relevant landmark thumbnails. The geographic course stays vector-rendered from its separately licensed existing coordinate database. Hero compositions are atmospheric and non-geographic.
sourceOfLandmarkLabels: Accepted route-specific metadata in domain/src/main/java/org/racedaydreams/domain/support/DreamRoutes.java, generated DreamCartography.java and docs/dream-route-data/city-context.json. Historical assignments retain their own course/landmark identities; shared city art does not relabel them.
processing: Source plates remain untouched outside the repository. Heroes use source rectangle [0, 0, 1536, 512] and 1200 × 400 output. Clean poster starts are London 512, Berlin 522, Paris 531, Tokyo 549, New York 528: generated divider positions vary. Each poster uses a centred square crop within its nominal 512 px column, then 400 × 400 output; no stretching and no retained hero strips or divider bands. Exact crops, source hashes and encoding are recorded per asset.
